newsitem.title: USA: Conversion to make private placement.
newsitem.headline: Conversion to make private placement.

text.p: Conversion Technologies International Inc said Wednesday that it planned to make a private placement of preferred stock to accredited investors.
The company said the placement was expected to generate between a minimum of $2.0 million and a maximum of $7.0 million.
Each share will have a par value of $10, it said.

Each of them will initially be convertible into conversion common stock at the lesser of $2.00 per share and the average closing bid price of the stock for the 30-trading-day period preceding the closing of the placement, it said.

"In the case of the minimum offering, assuming a $2.00 conversion price, the Private Placement will result in the issuance of 1,100,000 common stock equivalents ...or 17.2 (percent) of the Common Stock to be outstanding upon consummation of the previously-announced merger with Octagon, Inc," it said.
A maximum offering will result in the issuance of 3.85 million stock equivalents or 60.3 percent of stock outstanding, it added.
The company did not elaborate on the merger and its officials were unavailable for comment.
Conversion Technologies makes substrates for use as industrial abrasives for surface cleaning and recycles cathode ray tube glass for sale to manufacturers.
